sentences.en: After the prisoners escaped, the police set about recapturing them.
sentences.zh: 囚犯逃走后，警方设法重新捕获了他们。

sentences.en: Five prisoners were recaptured, but three others are still at large.
sentences.zh: 五名囚犯被重新捕获，但另外三名仍然在逃。

sentences.en: All Jews were expelled from Buda after its recapture by Hungary.
sentences.zh: 匈牙利重新占领布达后，所有犹太人都被迫离开了那里。
